notes: Safety Tracker v2.10.71 CLEAN. Clarifies document scope: every controlled RA, COSHH RA, SSW and Toolbox Talk should be explicitly scoped to either Whole hotel / Everyone once or the relevant department; whole-hotel material is not duplicated into every department and person-specific assignment is treated as an exception. Department responsible-manager changes continue to show a warning and automatically flag all controlled RA/COSHH/SSW/TBT material assigned to that department for full review. Positions and six-month default/Manager-editable training frequency remain unchanged. Supabase migration hs_manager_change_notice_no_full_review_v21071 applied.
